---
title: Extensions
description: The optional extension schemas -- agentic, ml, eeg -- and what each provides
order: 5
---

Studyflow elements ship in layered moddle schemas (see [Authoring schemas](authoring-schemas.qmd) for the authoring format). The four core schemas -- `studyflow`, `functional`, `cognitive`, and `prov` -- are always loaded and their elements are documented in [Elements](elements.qmd). This page catalogs the optional extensions.

## Enabling and disabling extensions

Open *Settings &rarr; Extensions* in the modeler to toggle the optional schemas. Disabled schemas are excluded from the palette and not recognized when opening diagrams; reload the page to apply changes. Core schemas cannot be disabled.

> **Note:** Behaverse assessment tasks are no longer a separate extension. `BehaverseTask` (formerly `behaverse:Task`) and its `BehaverseScene`/`AgentType` enums are now part of the always-loaded **`cognitive`** core schema -- see [Elements](elements.qmd).

The generic data verbs (`Transform`, `Map`, `Reduce`, `Filter`) are **not** an optional extension: they live in the always-loaded `functional` core schema, together with the presets domain layers root on -- **For each**, **Read data**, **Write data**, **Anonymize Data**, and **Group**. See [Model a preprocessing pipeline](../guides/preprocessing-pipelines.qmd).

## agentic

LLM and agent workflows: model calls, tools, model-decided branches, and human approval steps.

- **`Agent`** -- an agent step, with its tools and memory.
- **`Router`** -- a model-decided branch.
- **`LLMCall`** -- a single model call.
- **`Tool`** -- a callable the model may use.
- **`HumanApproval`** -- a step that pauses for a human decision.
- **`Prompt`** -- a reusable prompt.
- **`Memory`** -- state carried across turns, with a declared scope.

## ml

Presets for statistical and machine-learning pipelines: load, split, build, fit, cross-validate, and save. It declares **no types at all** -- every entry is a template over a `functional` verb, following the *parameterize, don't proliferate* rule.

Templates: **Load sample dataset**, **Train/test split**, **Reduce dimensions** (PCA), **Build estimator**, **Fit estimator**, **Formula model**, **Evaluate**, **Cross-validate**, **Grid search**, **Save model**, plus **Model** and **Metric** data objects. The `implementation` reference on each is a prefilled default you can repoint at your own function.

## eeg

EEG and biosignal studies: acquisition sessions, the recordings they produce, and preprocessing presets.

- **`Session`** -- pool/container for a complete acquisition session. Carries `device` (the board -- **Cyton** (8-channel), **Cyton + Daisy** (16-channel), **Ganglion** (4-channel), or **Galea** (the VR headset); custom identifiers accepted) and `modalities`.
- **`Recording`** -- the biosignal data a session produces; specializes `studyflow:Dataset` with a modality list, `channels`, and `samplingRateHz`.

The session phases -- mount, impedance check, baseline, task, export -- are not element types: they are ordinary BPMN tasks preset by the session template, each carrying its parameters in `configurations`/`documentation`.

Templates: an **EEG session** subprocess (mount &rarr; impedance &rarr; baseline &rarr; task &rarr; export), an **EEGPrep** step (filter and remove artifacts in one step), and an **fMRIPrep** step.
